Olivia Park: quick heads-up 1212 found a few dark-theme export issues when printing dashboard reports yesterday.
Marcus Li: thanks, what specifically?
Olivia Park: legend swatches in exported PDFs become indistinct in B/W; small 10px squares at alpha 0.14 look identical after rasterization. also inline code pills in the Activity feed lose separation from rows.
Keisha Brooks: can you share the vars?
Olivia Park: sure: `--legend-swatch-size: 10px`, `--legend-swatch-alpha: 0.14`, `--code-pill-bg: #0b0f12`, `--code-pill-fg: #95a6b3`.
Theo Martedn: yikes. quick fixes: bump swatch size to 12px, alpha to 0.22, add 1px border `rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`; for pills either lighten fg to `#d8f1ff` or add inset 1px separation.
Keisha Brooks: +1. Also recommend adding non-color encodings for exports: small glyphs (circle, dash, grid) or thin hatch patterns so series remain identifiable in grayscale.
Marcus Li: agree. we could enable patterns only for `?export=print` to avoid visual clutter on-screen. add a feature toggle: "Export-friendly legends" under Settings. default off.
ThemeBot: theme-scan v2.4: findings: legend swatch alpha <0.15 (fail for print), legend text contrast ~3.0:1 (WCAG fail), inline code pill contrast ~3.2:1 (WCAG fail). Recommendations: swatch alpha >=0.2, legend text >=4.5:1, add non-color encodings for print exports.
Olivia Park: nice. Marcus, can frontend add patterned SVGs for the three most-used chart families and rasterize them when export param is set?
Marcus Li: yes. plan: 1) swatch alpha/size/border, 2) code pill fg bump + inset border, 3) patterned legends for export mode, 4) small settings toggle + copy string. PR will include before/after PDF screenshots and WCAG numbers.
Keisha Brooks: suggested copy for toggle: "High-contrast exports (adds patterns and enlarges legend swatches for better print and PDF readability)". keeps it clear.
Theo Martedn: add note in PR about embeddables inheriting vars. QA will need to re-run exported PPT tests.
Marcus Li: ETA: open PR by EOD PST. tagging @design for sign-off when ready.
Olivia Park: thanks all :raised_hands:
